message.content: {"caption":"A rounded rectangular prompt template for scoring an agent’s answer against a ground-truth answer.","description":"A monospaced text prompt inside a rounded rectangular border. It instructs an expert judge to evaluate answer correctness using three placeholders: Question [QUESTION], Ground-truth Answer [GROUND_TRUTH], and Agent’s Answer [AGENT_ANSWER]. It requests a score from 0.0 to 1.0 and defines six score bands: 1.0 for a perfect match or equivalent correct answer; 0.8–0.9 for mostly correct with minor differences; 0.6–0.7 for partially correct or a close approximation; 0.4–0.5 for some correct elements but significant errors; 0.2–0.3 for mostly incorrect with few correct elements; and 0.0–0.1 for completely incorrect or irrelevant. It asks for only a number between 0.0 and 1.0, giving “0.85” as an example. No arrows or other marks are shown.","figure_type":"other","chart_values":[]}
